description: Fetch a single taxon usage by its GBIF taxon key, from the GBIF backbone or any other checklist. Returns full classification, authorship, taxonomic status, vernacular name, descendant count, and publication reference. Use after gbif_match_species when you need the complete record rather than the match summary, or on a taxon usage key from gbif_search_species. datasetKey names the checklist the record belongs to, and key and the rank, parent, and accepted keys are taxon usage keys of that checklist. nubKey is the mapped backbone key, the one the occurrence tools take as taxonKey; it is absent where the backbone has no mapping. When taxonomicStatus is SYNONYM, acceptedKey and accepted fields identify the accepted taxon. The extinct field is absent (not false) on most records — only present on explicitly flagged taxa.

taxonKey.description: GBIF taxon key: a backbone key from gbif_match_species, or a taxon usage key of any checklist, such as key from gbif_search_species.

name: gbif_get_species

accepted.description: Scientific name of the accepted taxon when this record is a synonym.

acceptedKey.description: Taxon usage key of the accepted taxon, in the source checklist, when this record is a synonym.

classKey.description: Taxon usage key of the class, in the source checklist.

datasetKey.description: Source checklist dataset UUID, when GBIF supplies it.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No GBIF checklist has a taxon usage with this taxonKey. `invalid_filter`: GBIF rejected the taxonKey as unparseable — a value outside the 32-bit signed integer range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

extinct.description: True when the taxon is explicitly flagged as extinct. Absent on most records.

familyKey.description: Taxon usage key of the family, in the source checklist.

genusKey.description: Taxon usage key of the genus, in the source checklist.

key.description: Taxon usage key within the source checklist; not necessarily a backbone key.

kingdomKey.description: Taxon usage key of the kingdom, in the source checklist.

nubKey.description: Mapped backbone taxon key for occurrence queries, when GBIF supplies it. Otherwise resolve the name with gbif_match_species.

numDescendants.description: Count of descendant taxa under this taxon in its source checklist.

numOccurrences.description: Occurrence record count, when GBIF includes one. Its taxon record endpoint does not, so this is normally absent — count with gbif_count_occurrences, passing nubKey as taxonKey, instead.

orderKey.description: Taxon usage key of the order, in the source checklist.

parent.description: Name of the immediate parent taxon.

parentKey.description: Taxon usage key of the immediate parent, in the source checklist.

phylumKey.description: Taxon usage key of the phylum, in the source checklist.

speciesKey.description: Taxon usage key of the species, in the source checklist.

taxonomicStatus.description: ACCEPTED, SYNONYM, DOUBTFUL, etc. SYNONYM means acceptedKey/accepted are populated.

title: Get Species Record
